items.title: Has Vulcan Materials (VMC) Run Too Far Above Fair Value?
items.summary: Vulcan Materials has delivered a strong 58.4% gain over the past five years, yet current checks suggest the stock now trades at a premium to what its cash flows and market multiples imply. Both the intrinsic value estimate based on Discounted Cash Flow and simple valuation ratios point to an overvalued profile rather than a clear bargain at recent prices.
